item.title: Back to playback singing with Chal Re Mana Jaau
item.description: Planet Bollywood interviewed Nihira about Chal Re Mana Jaau from the Marathi film Ata Thambaycha Naay!, composed and co-sung by Gulraj Singh with lyrics by Manoj Yadav: her return to film playback after years of independent releases. Read the interview (Planet Bollywood)

item.title: Ishq Manayein Kya? returns as a swing version
item.description: Three years after the salsa original, Nihira re-recorded Ishq Manayein Kya? with new rock-and-roll and swing arrangements by Tanmay Pawar, keeping Manoj Yadav's lyrics. Read the feature (Planet Bollywood)

item.title: Tumi: Nihira's first Bengali single
item.description: In an interview with Planet Bollywood, Nihira talks about composing Tumi, her first song in Bengali, written by Santanu Ghatak and produced by Ashwin Srinivasan. Read the interview (Planet Bollywood)

item.title: Monsoon single Toote Chhaate released
item.description: Music Unplugged reported on Toote Chhaate, a rain-and-romance song composed and sung by Nihira, written by Alok Ranjan Srivastava and arranged by Rhythm Shaw, with an illustrated video by Barun Roy. Read the article (Music Unplugged)

item.title: Trishna honoured at the Clef Music Awards 2023
item.description: At the third edition of the Clef Music Awards, Nihira's EP Trishna won in two categories: Best Artist (Hindustani Classical) and Album of the Year. Read the winners list (Lokmat Times)

item.title: Music Unplugged features the Trishna EP
item.description: Music Unplugged reported on Trishna, Nihira's first EP, released in December 2022: four songs about Radha's longing and love for Krishna, composed and sung by Nihira. Read the article (Music Unplugged)

item.title: Rolling Stone India picks Trishna
item.description: Rolling Stone India included the Trishna EP in its round-up of new releases to tune in to. Read on Rolling Stone India

item.title: A Hindi song with Cuban salsa
item.description: Asian Lite featured Ishq Manayein Kya?, Nihira's Hindi salsa recorded with the Cuban band Orquesta Son Diamantes and produced in Barcelona. Read the article (Asian Lite)
